curriculum_stages.name: Basic Hit or Stand
curriculum_stages.description: Agent learns the fundamental actions of hitting and standing. The goal is to understand basic hand values and when to take risks to improve the hand or play it safe.

curriculum_stages.name: Hit, Stand, and Dealer Awareness
curriculum_stages.description: The agent reinforces hit/stand decisions, focusing on dealer's upcard. Agent needs to learn to adjust strategy based on the dealer's potential hand. Target win rate reflects the advantage dealer possesses in Blackjack.

curriculum_stages.name: Introducing Double Down
curriculum_stages.description: The agent learns to use the Double Down action strategically, doubling the bet when it has a favorable hand, based on the dealer's upcard. This introduces higher risk/reward decision-making.

curriculum_stages.name: Introducing Split
curriculum_stages.description: The agent learns when to split pairs to improve the odds. This requires understanding the value of splitting certain pairs against different dealer upcards.

curriculum_stages.name: Double Down and Split
curriculum_stages.description: The agent combines Double Down and Split actions into its repertoire. It must now evaluate when to use each action strategically, requiring more sophisticated hand evaluation skills. The target win rate increases to reflect added player options.

curriculum_stages.name: Early Surrender
curriculum_stages.description: The agent learns when to use Early Surrender to minimize losses when facing unfavorable situations. Requires evaluating hand against dealer upcard and knowing when the hand is a long shot.

curriculum_stages.name: Insurance
curriculum_stages.description: The agent learns when to take Insurance when the dealer shows an Ace. This action is statistically difficult to master profitably, this stage forces the agent to evaluate the action.

curriculum_stages.name: All Actions Available
curriculum_stages.description: The agent has access to all available actions and must now optimize its strategy to maximize its win rate. This is the final test of mastery of all Blackjack strategies.
